name: draw-text.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  draw-text.scss — MANIFEST for the DrawText per-character writing
//  animation (shadow-scoped via ?inline). Split by surface into draw-text/
//  partials (imported below):
//    _core            :host + word/space/char spans + inline-link underline
//    _triggers        mount/slide/viewport reveal triggers + pending/done
//    _keyframes       char-draw keyframes (desktop + ≤960px variant)
//    _mobile          ≤768px word-level animation path
//    _reduced-motion  reduced-motion overrides + focus ring scope
//
//  --i          : character index (set from template)
//  --char-delay : ms between each character (set from template, default 100ms)
//  --offset     : ms base delay before any character starts (for sequencing)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

@import 'draw-text/core';
@import 'draw-text/triggers';
@import 'draw-text/keyframes';
@import 'draw-text/mobile';
@import 'draw-text/reduced-motion';
